answers.description: An offline-first Android productivity and screen discipline app built with Flutter, focused on strict app blocking and time‑blocking via Accessibility Services.
answers.problem_statement: Passive wellness apps lack the friction needed to prevent distraction. This project solves that by enforcing strict screen discipline through mechanical flip‑clock focus sessions, YouTube Study Mode whitelists, and 2/5/10/20 minute intervention overlays.
answers.target_users: Students and individuals undertaking high‑stakes, intense academic workflows (such as IOQM, INMO, or JEE Advanced preparation) who require absolute focus and accountability through a streak‑based system.
key_goals: Strictly enforce the offline‑first architecture using SQLite, Hive, and Riverpod 3.x, alongside the Android MethodChannel IPC bridge.
Maintain strict adherence to the flat 2D "Rustic Medley" design system across all generated UI components.
Seamlessly coordinate tasks between the Flutter/UI agent (Code1) and the Tailwind mockup agent (Code2) while maintaining the centralized agent worklog.
answers.voice_tone: Professional and technical, concise and direct with no buttering, flattery, or unnecessary compliments.
design_principles: Consistent UI/UX: Enforces the strict flat 2D, zero‑blue color palette across Code1 and Code2.
Accessibility‑first: Prioritizes core Android Accessibility Services for app blocking and friction mechanics.
Performance first: Protects the offline‑first SQLite/Hive architecture and drift‑free delta arithmetic used in the focus timer.
answers.verification_checkpoints: after each phase and after each task
